D4_environment_reconstructable.justification: No env spec file in repo, but paper mentions packages: DESeq2, RnBeads, ggplot2, mMCP-counter, STAR==2.3.5a. Manual environment construction possible.

D5_results_match.justification: Full-agent: exact — DESeq2 on GEO GSE308855. Detected SWAPPED TREATMENT LABELS for 2 of 6 normal tissue samples in GEO metadata (M_37_3_H1 labeled HDM but mouse 37=Vehicle; M_40_2_H2 labeled VEH but mouse 40=HDM). Corrected using methylation sample_annotation.csv from GitHub repo. With corrected labels: tumor DEGs=599 (exact, 0%), normal DEGs=1386 vs 1390 (0.3% diff). Label swap collapsed normal DEGs from ~1390 to 23.
evidence: Root cause: GEO metadata label swap for 2 normal tissue samples
